problem.title: Customers message at night. Whoever *replies at night* wins them.
problem.lead: It's midnight. A patient with a toothache messages five clinics on WhatsApp and Messenger. How many reply? None.
problem.body: In the morning she's booked with *whichever clinic replied first* — not the best one, the fastest. Customers don't wait around; they message the next business on the list.

msgs.text: Hi, I'd like to book a check-up with Dr. Ahmed tomorrow.. how much is it?
Where exactly is the clinic? Do you accept insurance?
I need to see the doctor urgently, is there an appointment tomorrow?

problem.punch: By morning, all three were patients somewhere else.

villains.title: Foreign tools
villains.desc: Paid in dollars with an international card, an English dashboard, and most importantly — they can't hold a conversation in Egyptian Arabic
